finding.source: P7-09 / feat-054 campaign, plugin ab-f95a046886ecbe3efcf97251 (astrbot_plugin_mc_update), command mcupdate_latest
finding.symptom: Native side returned the plugin text; the Federated side returned no reply.
finding.cause: Each Python Host encoded its NDJSON frame with .encode("utf-8"), which raises UnicodeEncodeError on str values containing surrogates that plugins build from escapes such as the pair U+D83D U+DCF0; the reply frame was lost. The Koishi Host uses JSON.stringify, which writes a lone surrogate as a \udXXX escape, and the Core rejects such a frame as invalid JSON and closes the whole Host session.

fix.rule: Before a frame is written, string values and object keys are made well-formed: a valid surrogate pair becomes its character, a lone surrogate becomes U+FFFD; already encodable text is unchanged byte for byte.
fix.packaging: AstrBot HOST_FILES (lab/astrbot_census.py), the P7-09 campaign source list (lab/astrbot_campaign_plan.py, which also lacked inventory.py) and the Phase 4 NoneBot copy list (lab/automation/phase4_campaign.py) now include frames.py; a test requires every list to cover each relative import of the Host worker.

scope: Koishi Worker images built from deploy/lab/linux/tool-surface-runtime.Dockerfile pick up the fix when next built; AstrBot bundles copy the Host source at preparation time, so the fix applies to new AstrBot bundles immediately. No campaign result is rewritten.
